description: This file is a shell script used for firmware upgrade processes on a Ubiquiti Networks device, specifically for the ER-X model. It contains functions to determine and update the target kernel partition, manage UBI (Unsorted Block Images) volumes, and perform the actual upgrade process.

methods.name: ubnt_get_target_kernel
methods.description: Determines the target kernel partition ('kernel1' or 'kernel2') based on the current kernel index stored at a specific offset.

methods.name: ubnt_update_target_kernel
methods.description: Updates the kernel index at a specific offset within the factory MTD partition to select the desired kernel ('kernel1' or 'kernel2').

methods.name: platform_upgrade_ubnt_erx
methods.description: Executes the upgrade process for the Ubiquiti ER-X device, including kernel selection, UBI volume cleanup, and invoking the NAND upgrade command.
